article.title: Kantar與Quilt.AI公布LaunchSignals，追蹤新品早期市場訊號
article.summary: Kantar與Quilt.AI公布LaunchSignals，利用公開數位資料協助品牌觀察新品上市後的反應。
highlights: 工具整合評論、搜尋、社群對話、AI能見度及競品活動等訊號。
公布的19個市場包括新加坡、日本、澳洲及印度。
article.why: 新品團隊可把搜尋和消費者評論放回同一個上市週期，找出需要調整的訊息或顧客預期。
article.next_step: 選一項新產品，先按市場及週次整理搜尋、評論和銷售資料，再核對工具能覆蓋哪些訊號。
article.detail: Kantar表示，LaunchSignals可比較新品與競爭產品或過往推出的差異，並就訊息、促銷及價格溝通提供建議。工具以公開數位證據提供早期觀察，另有問卷及實際使用者研究工具可供配合。行銷團隊可以先列出每個訊號的觀察期間及資料來源，再檢查建議是否適用於自己的產品和市場。
article.title_en: Kantar and Quilt.AI introduce LaunchSignals for early product feedback
article.summary_en: Kantar and Quilt.AI announced LaunchSignals to help brands examine early product-launch reactions using public digital evidence.
highlights_en: It combines reviews, search, social conversation, AI visibility and competitor activity.
Its stated 19-market coverage includes Singapore, Japan, Australia and India.
article.why_en: Launch teams can examine search and reviews within the same launch window to identify messages or expectations to address.
article.next_step_en: Organize search, reviews and sales by market and week for one new product, then check which signals the tool covers.
article.detail_en: Kantar says LaunchSignals compares products with competitors or past launches and suggests responses in messaging, promotion and price communication. It provides early digital evidence alongside separate survey and user research tools. Teams can document the observation period and source for each signal before judging whether a recommendation fits their product and market.
